name: Block Region Permissions
description: Adds permissions for administering 'blocks' based on each theme's regions.

suggests.drupal/block_content_permissions: Block Content Permissions adds permissions for administering 'block content types' and 'block content'.

project_description:
The Block Region Permissions module allows you to control access to administer blocks within each theme's regions.

 The following permissions are added: 
 
 Administer: [ theme ] - [ region ] 
 Grants access to manage a theme's region:
 
 View region's header, message, and blocks on block layout page 
 View region in region selector fields on block layout page 
 View region in region selector field on configure and place block pages 
 Update or delete blocks placed in region 
 
 
 
 Installation and Setup 
 
 Install the module as you normally would any module. 
 Assign permissions created by this module to the role you want to grant access. Adding or removing themes and/or regions after enabling this module will automatically update on the permissions page. 
 Add the following core permissions to allow the role access to the administer blocks pages:
 
 Use the administration pages 
 Administer blocks 
 
 
 
 Note: The "Administer blocks" permission also grants full access to all pages related to block content and block content types. To restrict access to those pages, you can use the Block Content Permissions module.
